scenes.text: Since when did staying home stop needing an excuse?

scenes.label: more mentions of home as a refuge in May than in January 2026

scenes.text: Yo, neta amo salir con mis amigos pero prefiero estar en mi casa, y si ya cancelan, no me quejo.
scenes.translation: Honestly, I love going out with my friends but I'd rather be at home, and if they cancel, I don't complain.

scenes.text: Treat home as a destination. Silence, coffee and a good bed are a plan too.
